name: creator-content-kit
description: 13 skills plus a shared core that help an Instagram creator plan, write, check and improve their own content: reels, captions, carousels, stories, comments, replies, DMs, niche research, profile and performance audits, and a content calendar. Drafts by default; an optional publisher posts approved content through Meta's official API only with a per-post approval code. Never uses passwords.
